lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows; inter-spot spacing increases along the anterior-posterior axis from the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot lines, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes on the lateral mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a highlight on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5 high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located on the posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable notch or irregularity is visible on the trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gills shows a high-density pattern of minute spots that transitions into the larger, structured grid of the flank.
